summary: This configuration file sets up a connection to a PostgreSQL database for what appears to be a PostgREST API server. It specifies the database location and credentials, which schema to expose, and which database role to use for unauthenticated requests.

explanations.1: This is the connection string that tells the application how to reach the PostgreSQL database—it includes the username, password, server address, port, and database name.
explanations.2: This limits the API to only expose tables and functions from the 'api' schema, rather than exposing everything in the database.
explanations.3: This sets the database user role that will be used for any requests that don't provide authentication credentials, restricting what unauthenticated visitors can do.
